conclusion: The existing 5-pF-per-leg, 10-ohm sampled-input boundary cannot support a deterministic 12-bit quarter-LSB allocation: six-sigma differential kT/C noise alone is 281.35 uV. A switch topology cannot repair this allocation.
required_before_next_sampler_layout: A real IF driver/buffer whose extracted output resistance, current delivery, noise, linearity, and stability are verified against the selected capacitor load.

At least 424.974 pF per differential hold leg for the stated six-sigma thermal-only limit; additional capacitor or a repartitioned error budget is required for switch, reference, mismatch, jitter, and ADC errors.
An explicit differential bottom-plate or charge-injection-cancellation sampler whose non-overlap timing is checked with that driver and capacitor, not the rejected 5-pF boundary.
thermal_model: independent kT/C noise on two equal hold capacitors; no switch, buffer, mismatch, jitter, reference, or ADC noise credited
